Wine はコンピュータを個人の投資管理に使っていたので消費財であり、MJC はその購入資金を融資したので購入代金担保権（PMSI）を持ちます。UCC §9-320(b) により、消費者から消費財を、担保権を知らずに、対価を払って、個人・家族・家庭用に買った買主は担保権の負担なく取得できますが、それは購入前に担保権者が融資説明書を届出していない場合に限られます。MJC は Jacobs の購入前に届出済みなので、担保権は Jacobs の手元のコンピュータにも及び（§9-315(a)(1)）、Wine の債務不履行後に MJC は取り戻せます（§9-609）。

Jacobs が担保権を知らなかったことや家族用であることは消費者間取引の買主保護の要件ですが、MJC が届出しているため保護は受けられません。Wine はコンピュータの販売業者ではないので、Jacobs は通常の営業過程の買主でもありません。また、購入によって Jacobs が Wine の債務を個人的に負うことはなく、MJC の権利は担保物に対するものです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.13

questions.stem:
Under the Secured Transactions Article of the UCC, what would be the order of priority for the following security interests in consumer goods?
I. Financing agreement filed on April 1
II. Possession of the collateral by a creditor on April 10
III. Financing agreement perfected on April 15

choices.label: A
choices.text: I, II, III

choices.label: B
choices.text: II, I, III

choices.label: C
choices.text: II, III, I

choices.label: D
choices.text: III, II, I

questions.explanation:
Under UCC §9-322(a)(1), conflicting perfected security interests in the same collateral rank according to priority in time of filing or perfection, whichever occurs first. The interest filed on April 1 ranks first, the interest perfected by possession on April 10 ranks second (possession is a valid method of perfection for goods under §9-313(a)), and the interest perfected on April 15 ranks third.

An order that places the April 10 possession or the April 15 perfection ahead of the April 1 filing is incorrect, because perfection by possession has no special priority over an earlier filing, and a later perfection cannot outrank an earlier filing.
questions.explanationJa:
UCC §9-322(a)(1) により、同じ担保物に対する対抗要件を備えた担保権どうしは、届出または対抗要件具備のいずれか早い時点の順で優先します。4月1日に届出された担保権が1位、4月10日に占有で対抗要件を備えた担保権が2位（物品は占有で対抗要件を備えられます、§9-313(a)）、4月15日に対抗要件を備えた担保権が3位です。

占有による対抗要件具備に、先行する届出より優先する特別の効力はありません。また後から対抗要件を備えた担保権が先の届出を追い越すこともないため、4月10日や4月15日の担保権を先に置く順序は誤りです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.14

questions.stem: Larkin is a wholesaler of computers. Larkin sold 40 computers to Elk Appliance for $80,000. Elk paid $20,000 down and signed a promissory note for the balance. Elk also executed a security agreement giving Larkin a security interest in Elk's inventory, including the computers. Larkin perfected its security interest by properly filing a financing statement in the state of Whiteacre. Six months later, Elk moved its business to the state of Blackacre, taking the computers. On arriving in Blackacre, Elk secured a loan from Quarry Bank and signed a security agreement putting up all inventory (including the computers) as collateral. Quarry perfected its security interest by properly filing a financing statement in the state of Blackacre. Two months after arriving in Blackacre, Elk went into default on both debts. Which of the following statements is correct?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Quarry's security interest is superior because Larkin's time to file a financing statement in Blackacre had expired prior to Quarry's filing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Quarry's security interest is superior because Quarry had no actual notice of Larkin's security interest.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Larkin's security interest is superior even though at the time of Elk's default Larkin had not perfected its security interest in the state of Blackacre.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Larkin's security interest is superior provided it repossesses the computers before Quarry does.

questions.explanation:
Larkin perfected first by filing in Whiteacre. Under UCC §9-316(a)(2), when the debtor relocates to another jurisdiction, a security interest perfected by filing in the old jurisdiction remains perfected for four months after the change of the debtor's location (and longer if the old filing would otherwise lapse later). Elk defaulted only two months after moving to Blackacre, so Larkin's security interest was still perfected even though Larkin had not filed in Blackacre. (If Elk is a registered organization, its location stays in its state of organization under §9-307(e), and the Whiteacre filing simply remains effective.) Under the first-to-file-or-perfect rule of §9-322(a)(1), Larkin's earlier perfected interest is superior to Quarry's later filing.

Larkin's time to file in Blackacre had not expired when Quarry filed, because Quarry filed shortly after the move, well within four months. Priority between filed security interests does not depend on whether a later creditor had actual notice; the filing system gives constructive notice. Larkin's priority also does not depend on repossessing the computers first.
questions.explanationJa:
Larkin は Whiteacre 州で届出して先に対抗要件を備えています。UCC §9-316(a)(2) により、債務者が別の州へ所在地を移しても、旧州での届出による対抗要件は移転後4か月間（旧届出がそれより後に失効する場合はその時点まで）継続します。Elk は Blackacre 州へ移ってから2か月で債務不履行になっているので、Blackacre 州で届出していなくても Larkin の担保権は対抗要件を備えたままです（Elk が登録組織であれば、所在地は設立州のままなので（§9-307(e)）Whiteacre 州の届出がそのまま有効です）。§9-322(a)(1) の「先に届出・対抗要件を備えた者が優先」のルールにより、Larkin が Quarry に優先します。

Quarry は移転直後に届出しており、4か月の猶予期間は過ぎていないので、期限切れを理由に Quarry が優先するという説明は誤りです。届出された担保権どうしの優先は、後順位債権者が実際に知っていたかどうかでは決まりません（届出が擬制的な通知になります）。また、Larkin の優先は先に担保物を取り戻すことを条件としません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.15

questions.stem: A party who filed a security interest in inventory on April 1, Year 4, would have a superior interest to which of the following parties?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A holder of a mechanic's lien whose lien was filed on March 15, Year 4

choices.label: B
choices.text: A holder of a purchase money security interest in after-acquired property filed on March 20, Year 4

choices.label: C
choices.text: A purchaser in the ordinary course of business who purchased on April 10, Year 4

choices.label: D
choices.text: A judgment lien creditor who filed its judgment on April 15, Year 4

questions.explanation:
A judgment lien creditor whose lien arises on April 15 is subordinate to a security interest perfected by filing on April 1. Under UCC §9-317(a)(2), a security interest is subordinate to a lien creditor only if the lien arises before the security interest is perfected (or before a financing statement is filed and the conditions of attachment are met), so the earlier-filed security interest prevails.

The holder of the mechanic's lien filed on March 15 is not subordinate, because that lien arose before the April 1 filing, so the later-filed security interest cannot take priority over it. The holder of the purchase money security interest filed on March 20 filed first and therefore has priority under §9-322(a)(1) (and a properly perfected inventory PMSI has special priority under §9-324(b)). A buyer in the ordinary course of business who purchases inventory on April 10 takes free of the seller's security interest even though it is perfected (§9-320(a)).
questions.explanationJa:
4月15日に差押えの効力が生じた判決債権者（judgment lien creditor）は、4月1日に届出された担保権に劣後します。UCC §9-317(a)(2) により、担保権が差押債権者に劣後するのは、差押えが担保権の対抗要件具備（または届出と attach 要件の充足）より前に生じた場合だけなので、先に届出した担保権が優先します。

3月15日に届け出られた修理業者の先取特権（mechanic's lien）は4月1日の届出より前に成立しているので、後から届出した担保権がこれに優先することはありません。3月20日に届出された PMSI は先に届出しているので §9-322(a)(1) で優先します（棚卸資産の PMSI には §9-324(b) の特別の優先もあります）。4月10日に在庫を買った通常の営業過程の買主は、対抗要件を備えた担保権であっても負担なく取得します（§9-320(a)）。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.16

questions.stem:
In what order are the following obligations paid after a secured creditor rightfully sells the debtor's collateral after repossession?
I. Debt owed to any junior security holder
II. Secured party's reasonable sale expenses
III. Debt owed to the secured party

choices.label: A
choices.text: I, II, III

choices.label: B
choices.text: II, I, III

choices.label: C
choices.text: II, III, I

choices.label: D
choices.text: III, II, I

questions.explanation:
UCC §9-615(a) sets the order for applying the cash proceeds of a disposition after default: first, the reasonable expenses of retaking, holding, preparing for disposition, and disposing of the collateral (including reasonable attorney's fees if provided for in the agreement); second, the obligation secured by the security interest under which the disposition is made; third, obligations secured by subordinate security interests whose holders made an authenticated demand before distribution. Any surplus goes to the debtor (§9-615(d)).

Therefore the sale expenses come first, then the debt owed to the foreclosing secured party, then the debt owed to junior security holders. An order that pays junior security holders before the foreclosing secured party, or pays the secured debt before the sale expenses, is contrary to §9-615(a).
questions.explanationJa:
UCC §9-615(a) は、債務不履行後の処分代金の充当順序を定めています。1番目に担保物の取戻し・保管・処分準備・処分の合理的な費用（契約に定めがあれば合理的な弁護士費用を含む）、2番目に処分を行った担保権者の被担保債務、3番目に分配前に認証された請求をした後順位担保権者の債務です。残余は債務者に返します（§9-615(d)）。

したがって「売却費用 → 担保権者への債務 → 後順位担保権者への債務」の順です。後順位担保権者を担保権者より先にする順序や、被担保債務を売却費用より先にする順序は §9-615(a) に反します。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.17

questions.stem:
Drew bought a computer for personal use from Hale Corp. for $3,000. Drew paid $2,000 in cash and signed a security agreement for the balance. Hale properly filed the security agreement. Drew defaulted in paying the balance of the purchase price. Hale asked Drew to pay the balance. When Drew refused, Hale peacefully repossessed the computer.

Under the UCC Secured Transactions Article, which of the following rights will Drew have?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Redeem the computer after Hale sells it

choices.label: B
choices.text: Recover the sale price from Hale after Hale sells the computer

choices.label: C
choices.text: Force Hale to sell the computer

choices.label: D
choices.text: Prevent Hale from selling the computer

questions.explanation:
Hale holds a purchase money security interest in consumer goods, and Drew has paid $2,000 of the $3,000 price, which is more than 60% of the cash price. Under UCC §9-620(e), a secured party that has taken possession of such collateral must dispose of it within 90 days after taking possession (§9-620(f)) and may not keep it in full satisfaction of the debt (strict foreclosure), unless the debtor waives this right in an agreement authenticated after default (§9-624(b)). Drew can therefore force Hale to sell the computer.

Drew's right to redeem under §9-623 exists only until the secured party has disposed of the collateral (or contracted to dispose of it), so Drew cannot redeem after the sale. Drew is not entitled to the sale price; the proceeds go first to expenses and the secured debt, and Drew receives only any surplus (§9-615). Drew cannot prevent the sale, because after default a secured party may take possession and dispose of the collateral in a commercially reasonable manner (§9-609, §9-610).
questions.explanationJa:
Hale は消費財に対する購入代金担保権（PMSI）を持ち、Drew は代金 $3,000 のうち $2,000（現金価格の60%超）を支払っています。UCC §9-620(e) により、この場合に担保物を占有した担保権者は、占有から90日以内に処分しなければならず（§9-620(f)）、債務の代わりに担保物を取得すること（strict foreclosure）はできません。例外は、債務者が債務不履行後に認証した合意でこの権利を放棄した場合だけです（§9-624(b)）。したがって Drew は Hale に売却を強制できます。

受戻し権（§9-623）は担保権者が処分（または処分の契約）をするまでしか行使できないので、売却後に受け戻すことはできません。売却代金は費用と被担保債務に充当され、Drew が受け取れるのは残余だけです（§9-615）。また債務不履行後、担保権者は担保物を取り戻して商業上合理的な方法で処分できるので（§9-609、§9-610）、Drew が売却を止めることもできません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.19

questions.stem:
Drew bought a computer for personal use from Hale Corp. for $3,000. Drew paid $2,000 in cash and signed a security agreement for the balance. Hale properly filed the security agreement. Drew defaulted in paying the balance of the purchase price. Hale asked Drew to pay the balance. When Drew refused, Hale peacefully repossessed the computer.

Under the UCC Secured Transactions Article, which of the following remedies will Hale have?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Obtain a deficiency judgment against Drew for the amount owed

choices.label: B
choices.text: Sell the computer and retain any surplus over the amount owed

choices.label: C
choices.text: Retain the computer over Drew's objection

choices.label: D
choices.text: Sell the computer without notifying Drew

questions.explanation:
Under UCC §9-615(d)(2), if the proceeds of the disposition of collateral are insufficient to satisfy the secured obligation, the obligor is liable for any deficiency. Hale may therefore sell the computer and, if the proceeds do not cover the balance owed, obtain a deficiency judgment against Drew for the amount still owed.

Hale cannot keep any surplus; under §9-615(d)(1) the surplus must be paid to the debtor. Hale cannot retain the computer over Drew's objection, because Drew has paid more than 60% of the cash price of consumer goods subject to a PMSI, so Hale must dispose of it (§9-620(e)); acceptance in satisfaction also requires the debtor's consent or lack of objection (§9-620(a)). Hale cannot sell without notice, because a secured party must send the debtor an authenticated notification of disposition (§9-611(b)).
questions.explanationJa:
UCC §9-615(d)(2) により、担保物の処分代金で被担保債務を弁済しきれない場合、債務者は不足額（deficiency）について責任を負います。したがって Hale はコンピュータを売却し、残額に足りなければ Drew に対して不足額の支払いを求める判決（deficiency judgment）を得ることができます。

余剰が出た場合は債務者に支払わなければならず（§9-615(d)(1)）、Hale が保持することはできません。Drew は消費財の PMSI で現金価格の60%超を支払っているので Hale は処分しなければならず（§9-620(e)）、また債務の代わりの取得には債務者の同意または異議の不存在が必要なので（§9-620(a)）、Drew の異議を押し切って保持することもできません。さらに処分前には債務者に認証された通知を送る必要があり（§9-611(b)）、通知なしの売却もできません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Secured Transaction Q.20

questions.stem:
Strong Corp. filed a voluntary petition in bankruptcy under the reorganization provisions of Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. A reorganization plan was filed and agreed to by all necessary parties. The court confirmed the plan and a final decree was entered.

Which of the following parties ordinarily must approve the plan?

1/2 of the secured creditors | 2/3 of the shareholders

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | No

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | Yes

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §1126(c), a class of creditors accepts a Chapter 11 plan only if creditors holding at least two-thirds in dollar amount and more than one-half in number of the allowed claims in that class vote to accept. Approval by one-half of the secured creditors is therefore not, by itself, the acceptance standard, so the first column is No. Under §1126(d), a class of equity interests accepts the plan if holders of at least two-thirds in amount of the interests vote to accept, so approval by two-thirds of the shareholders is ordinarily required, giving Yes. (A class that is not impaired is deemed to accept under §1126(f), and a plan can be confirmed over a dissenting class only through the cramdown rules of §1129(b).)

"Yes | Yes" and "Yes | No" wrongly treat one-half of the secured creditors as the acceptance requirement; creditor classes need both more than one-half in number and two-thirds in amount. "No | No" ignores that the shareholder class ordinarily votes on the plan under the two-thirds-in-amount standard.
questions.explanationJa:
チャプター11の再建計画は、債権者の組（クラス）では「債権額の3分の2以上かつ債権者数の過半数」の賛成で承認されます（§1126(c)）。単に担保付債権者の2分の1が承認すればよいわけではないので、左の列は No です。株主（持分権者）の組は、持分の3分の2以上の賛成で承認するので（§1126(d)）、通常は承認が必要で、右の列は Yes です（権利が変更されない組は承認したものとみなされ（§1126(f)）、反対する組があってもクラムダウン（§1129(b)）で認可される例外はあります）。

担保付債権者の2分の1を承認要件とする組み合わせは、人数と金額の二重要件を見落としています。株主の承認を不要とする組み合わせは、持分権者の組も3分の2基準で議決することを見落としています。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.2

questions.stem:
Strong Corp. filed a voluntary petition in bankruptcy under the reorganization provisions of Chapter 11 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. A reorganization plan was filed and agreed to by all necessary parties. The court confirmed the plan and a final decree was entered.

Which of the following statements best describes the effect of the entry of the court's final decree?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Strong Corp. will be discharged from all its debts and liabilities.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Strong Corp. will be discharged only from the debts owed creditors who agreed to the reorganization plan.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Strong Corp. will be discharged from all its debts and liabilities that arose before the date of confirmation of the plan.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Strong Corp. will be discharged from all its debts and liabilities that arose before the confirmation of the plan, except as otherwise provided in the plan, the order of confirmation, or the Bankruptcy Code.

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §1141(d)(1), confirmation of a Chapter 11 plan discharges the debtor from any debt that arose before the date of confirmation, except as otherwise provided in the plan, the order confirming the plan, or the Bankruptcy Code. Under §1141(a), the confirmed plan binds the debtor and all creditors, whether or not a particular creditor accepted the plan.

A discharge from all debts and liabilities is overstated, because only pre-confirmation debts are discharged and exceptions apply. A discharge only from debts owed to creditors who agreed to the plan is wrong, because the confirmed plan binds all creditors. A discharge from all pre-confirmation debts without qualification omits the exceptions in the plan, the confirmation order, and the Code.
questions.explanationJa:
チャプター11では、計画の認可により、認可日より前に生じた債務から免責されます。ただし、計画・認可命令・破産法で別段の定めがあるものは除かれます（§1141(d)(1)）。認可された計画は、賛成したかどうかにかかわらず全債権者を拘束します（§1141(a)）。

「すべての債務から免責」は、認可後の債務や例外を含めてしまうので言い過ぎです。「計画に同意した債権者への債務だけ免責」は、計画が全債権者を拘束する点と矛盾します。「認可前の債務すべてから免責」は、計画・命令・破産法による例外を落としています。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.3

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct concerning the voluntary filing of a petition in bankruptcy?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If the debtor has 12 or more creditors, the unsecured claims must total at least $22,000.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The debtor must be insolvent.

choices.label: C
choices.text: If the debtor has less than 12 creditors, the unsecured claims must total at least $18,000.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The petition may be filed jointly by spouses.

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §302(a), an individual and the individual's spouse may file a single joint petition, so a voluntary petition may be filed jointly by spouses. A voluntary petition under §301 does not require the debtor to be insolvent; the debtor only needs to be eligible under §109.

The statements about 12 or more creditors and about fewer than 12 creditors describe the numerical and dollar requirements that creditors must meet to file an involuntary petition under §303(b). They do not apply to a voluntary filing, and the dollar amounts are adjusted periodically for inflation under §104. The statement that the debtor must be insolvent is wrong because insolvency is not a condition of a voluntary petition.
questions.explanationJa:
夫婦は1通の共同申立て（joint petition）で破産を申し立てることができます（§302(a)）。任意申立て（§301）では、債務者が支払不能（insolvent）であることは要件ではありません。

債権者が12人以上・12人未満の場合の金額要件は、債権者が申し立てる強制申立て（§303(b)）の要件で、任意申立てには関係ありません（金額は§104により物価調整で改定されます）。「債務者が支払不能でなければならない」も任意申立ての要件ではないため誤りです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.4

questions.stem:
Dart, Inc., a closely held corporation, was petitioned involuntarily into bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. Dart contested the petition. Dart has not been paying its business debts as they became due, has defaulted on its mortgage loan payments, and owes back taxes to the IRS. The total cash value of Dart's bankruptcy estate after the sale of all assets and payment of administration expenses is $100,000. Dart has the following creditors:

- Fracon Bank is owed $75,000 principal and accrued interest on a mortgage loan secured by Dart's real property. The property was valued at and sold, in bankruptcy, for $70,000.
- The IRS has a $12,000 recorded judgment for unpaid corporate income tax.
- JOG Office Supplies has an unsecured claim of $3,000 that was timely filed.
- Nanstar Electric Co. has an unsecured claim of $1,200 that was not timely filed.
- Decoy Publications has a claim of $20,000, of which $2,000 is secured by Dart's inventory that was valued and sold, in bankruptcy, for $2,000. The claim was timely filed.

Which of the following statements would correctly describe the result of Dart's opposing the petition?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Dart will win because the petition should have been filed under Chapter 11.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Dart will win because there are not more than 12 creditors.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Dart will lose because it is not paying its debts as they become due.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Dart will lose because of its debt to the IRS.

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §303(h)(1), if an involuntary petition is contested, the court orders relief only if the debtor is generally not paying its undisputed debts as they become due (or a custodian took possession of the debtor's property within 120 days before filing). Dart has not been paying its business debts as they became due, so Dart will lose.

Creditors may file an involuntary petition under either Chapter 7 or Chapter 11 (§303(a)), and a closely held business corporation is a proper Chapter 7 debtor, so the argument that the petition should have been filed under Chapter 11 fails. Having fewer than 12 creditors does not defeat the petition; it only means a single qualifying creditor may file (§303(b)(2)). A single debt to the IRS is not the statutory test; the test is the general failure to pay debts as they come due.
questions.explanationJa:
強制申立てに債務者が異議を述べた場合、裁判所が救済命令を出すのは、債務者が弁済期の来た争いのない債務を一般的に支払っていないとき（または申立て前120日以内に管財人等が財産を占有したとき）です（§303(h)(1)）。Dartは弁済期の来た事業債務を支払っていないので、異議は通らず負けます。

強制申立てはチャプター7でもチャプター11でもでき（§303(a)）、閉鎖会社はチャプター7の債務者になれるので「チャプター11で申し立てるべきだった」は理由になりません。債権者が12人未満であることは、要件を満たす債権者1人で申し立てられるというだけで、異議の理由にはなりません。IRSへの債務があること自体は判断基準ではなく、基準は債務の一般的な不払いです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.6

questions.stem:
Dart, Inc., a closely held corporation, was petitioned involuntarily into bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. Dart contested the petition. Dart has not been paying its business debts as they became due, has defaulted on its mortgage loan payments, and owes back taxes to the IRS. The total cash value of Dart's bankruptcy estate after the sale of all assets and payment of administration expenses is $100,000. Dart has the following creditors:

- Fracon Bank is owed $75,000 principal and accrued interest on a mortgage loan secured by Dart's real property. The property was valued at and sold, in bankruptcy, for $70,000.
- The IRS has a $12,000 recorded judgment for unpaid corporate income tax.
- JOG Office Supplies has an unsecured claim of $3,000 that was timely filed.
- Nanstar Electric Co. has an unsecured claim of $1,200 that was not timely filed.
- Decoy Publications has a claim of $20,000, of which $2,000 is secured by Dart's inventory that was valued and sold, in bankruptcy, for $2,000. The claim was timely filed.

Assume that the bankruptcy estate was distributed.

What dollar amount would Nanstar Electric Co. receive?
questions.explanation:
Secured creditors are paid first from their collateral, then priority claims under 11 U.S.C. §507, then timely filed general unsecured claims, and only then tardily filed claims (§726(a)(3)).
Estate available: $100,000
Less Fracon Bank's secured claim (collateral sold for $70,000): $100,000 - $70,000 = $30,000
Less Decoy's secured portion (inventory sold for $2,000): $30,000 - $2,000 = $28,000
Less IRS priority tax claim (§507(a)(8)): $28,000 - $12,000 = $16,000
Timely general unsecured claims: Fracon deficiency $5,000 + JOG $3,000 + Decoy $18,000 = $26,000
Because $16,000 does not pay the $26,000 of timely general unsecured claims in full, nothing remains for the tardily filed claim. Nanstar receives $0.

The $1,200 amount treats Nanstar's claim as paid in full. Any partial payment, such as $800 or $1,000, would require the late claim to share in the distribution with the timely filed general unsecured claims, but a tardily filed claim is paid only after those claims are paid in full.
questions.explanationJa:
配当の順序は、担保付債権（担保物の売却代金から）→ 優先債権（§507）→ 期限内に届け出た一般無担保債権 → 期限後に届け出た債権（§726(a)(3)）です。
財団 $100,000 − Fracon の担保分 $70,000 − Decoy の担保分 $2,000 = $28,000
$28,000 − IRS の優先租税債権 $12,000 = $16,000
期限内の一般無担保債権は Fracon の不足額 $5,000 + JOG $3,000 + Decoy $18,000 = $26,000 で、$16,000 では全額払えません。
したがって期限後に届け出た Nanstar の $1,200 には配当が回らず、受取額は $0 です。$1,200 は全額配当とした誤り、$800 や $1,000 のような一部配当も、期限後の債権を期限内の債権と同順位で扱わない限り生じず、誤りです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.8

questions.stem:
Dart, Inc., a closely held corporation, was petitioned involuntarily into bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. Dart contested the petition. Dart has not been paying its business debts as they became due, has defaulted on its mortgage loan payments, and owes back taxes to the IRS. The total cash value of Dart's bankruptcy estate after the sale of all assets and payment of administration expenses is $100,000. Dart has the following creditors:

- Fracon Bank is owed $75,000 principal and accrued interest on a mortgage loan secured by Dart's real property. The property was valued at and sold, in bankruptcy, for $70,000.
- The IRS has a $12,000 recorded judgment for unpaid corporate income tax.
- JOG Office Supplies has an unsecured claim of $3,000 that was timely filed.
- Nanstar Electric Co. has an unsecured claim of $1,200 that was not timely filed.
- Decoy Publications has a claim of $20,000, of which $2,000 is secured by Dart's inventory that was valued and sold, in bankruptcy, for $2,000. The claim was timely filed.

Assume that the bankruptcy estate was distributed.

What total dollar amount would Fracon Bank receive on its secured and unsecured claims? (rounded to nearest hundred)
questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §506(a), Fracon's $75,000 claim is secured to the extent of the $70,000 value of its collateral, and the $5,000 balance is a general unsecured claim. Distribution under §726:
Estate available: $100,000
Less secured claims: $70,000 (Fracon) + $2,000 (Decoy) = $72,000, leaving $28,000
Less IRS priority tax claim (§507(a)(8)): $28,000 - $12,000 = $16,000
Timely general unsecured claims: $5,000 (Fracon) + $3,000 (JOG) + $18,000 (Decoy) = $26,000
Fracon's unsecured share: $16,000 x $5,000 / $26,000 = $3,077
Fracon's total: $70,000 + $3,077 = $73,077, rounded to $73,100

The $75,000 amount assumes Fracon's deficiency is paid in full, which ignores the IRS priority claim and the pro rata sharing with other unsecured creditors. The $70,000 amount ignores Fracon's right to share as a general unsecured creditor for its $5,000 deficiency. The $73,600 amount does not result from sharing the $16,000 pro rata among the $26,000 of timely general unsecured claims.
questions.explanationJa:
Fracon の債権 $75,000 のうち、担保物の価値 $70,000 までが担保付債権で、残り $5,000 は一般無担保債権になります（§506(a)）。
財団 $100,000 − 担保付債権（Fracon $70,000 + Decoy $2,000）= $28,000
$28,000 − IRS の優先租税債権 $12,000 = $16,000
期限内の一般無担保債権 $26,000（Fracon $5,000・JOG $3,000・Decoy $18,000）で按分すると、Fracon は $16,000 × 5,000/26,000 = $3,077
合計 $70,000 + $3,077 = $73,077 → 百ドル単位で $73,100 です。
$75,000 は不足額まで全額払われるとした誤り、$70,000 は不足額の按分配当を無視した誤り、$73,600 は $26,000 での按分計算になっていません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.9

questions.stem:
Dart, Inc., a closely held corporation, was petitioned involuntarily into bankruptcy under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code. Dart contested the petition. Dart has not been paying its business debts as they became due, has defaulted on its mortgage loan payments, and owes back taxes to the IRS. The total cash value of Dart's bankruptcy estate after the sale of all assets and payment of administration expenses is $100,000. Dart has the following creditors:

- Fracon Bank is owed $75,000 principal and accrued interest on a mortgage loan secured by Dart's real property. The property was valued at and sold, in bankruptcy, for $70,000.
- The IRS has a $12,000 recorded judgment for unpaid corporate income tax.
- JOG Office Supplies has an unsecured claim of $3,000 that was timely filed.
- Nanstar Electric Co. has an unsecured claim of $1,200 that was not timely filed.
- Decoy Publications has a claim of $20,000, of which $2,000 is secured by Dart's inventory that was valued and sold, in bankruptcy, for $2,000. The claim was timely filed.

Assume that the bankruptcy estate was distributed.

What dollar amount would the IRS receive?
questions.explanation:
Unsecured claims of governmental units for income taxes are priority claims under 11 U.S.C. §507(a)(8) and are paid before general unsecured claims (§726(a)(1)).
Estate available: $100,000
Less secured claims paid from collateral: $70,000 (Fracon) + $2,000 (Decoy) = $72,000, leaving $28,000
IRS priority claim: $12,000, which is fully covered by the $28,000 remaining
The IRS receives $12,000.

The $0 amount ignores the tax priority. The $8,000 and $10,000 amounts would leave part of the IRS claim unpaid even though $28,000 remains after the secured claims; a priority claim is paid in full before any general unsecured creditor receives a distribution.
questions.explanationJa:
法人所得税の租税債権は優先債権（§507(a)(8)）で、一般無担保債権より先に支払われます。
財団 $100,000 − 担保付債権（Fracon $70,000 + Decoy $2,000）= $28,000 が残るので、IRS の $12,000 は全額支払われます。
$0 は優先順位を無視した誤り、$8,000 や $10,000 は、担保付債権の弁済後に $28,000 残っているのに IRS の債権の一部しか払わない誤りです。優先債権は一般無担保債権への配当より先に全額支払われます。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.10

questions.stem: Under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code, a debtor will be denied a discharge in bankruptcy if the debtor

choices.label: A
choices.text: Fails to list a creditor

choices.label: B
choices.text: Owes alimony and support payments

choices.label: C
choices.text: Cannot pay administration expenses

choices.label: D
choices.text: Refuses to satisfactorily explain a loss of assets

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §727(a)(5), the court denies a Chapter 7 discharge if the debtor fails to explain satisfactorily any loss of assets or deficiency of assets to meet the debtor's liabilities. Denial of discharge means no debts are discharged.

Failing to list a creditor does not bar the discharge; it only makes the unscheduled debt nondischargeable in some cases (§523(a)(3)). Owing alimony and support makes those particular obligations nondischargeable (§523(a)(5)) but does not deny the discharge of other debts. Inability to pay administration expenses is not a ground for denying a discharge.
questions.explanationJa:
資産の減少や債務を賄うのに足りない理由を十分に説明できない場合、チャプター7の免責は拒否されます（§727(a)(5)）。免責の拒否は、すべての債務が免責されないことを意味します。

債権者を一覧に載せなかった場合は、その債務が免責されないことがある（§523(a)(3)）だけで、免責全体は拒否されません。扶養料・養育費の債務は、その債務自体が非免責になる（§523(a)(5)）だけです。管理費用を払えないことは免責拒否の事由ではありません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.11

questions.stem: Which of the following claims will not be discharged in bankruptcy?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A claim that arises from alimony or child support

choices.label: B
choices.text: A claim that arises from the debtor's breach of a contract

choices.label: C
choices.text: A claim brought by a secured creditor that remains unsatisfied after the sale of the collateral

choices.label: D
choices.text: Credit card bills and medical bills

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §523(a)(5), a domestic support obligation, such as alimony or child support, is excepted from discharge.

A claim arising from the debtor's breach of a contract is an ordinary unsecured debt and is dischargeable. A secured creditor's deficiency that remains after the sale of the collateral becomes a general unsecured claim and is dischargeable. Credit card bills and medical bills are ordinary consumer debts and are dischargeable unless a specific exception, such as fraud, applies.
questions.explanationJa:
扶養料や養育費などの家族扶養債務（domestic support obligation）は免責されません（§523(a)(5)）。

契約違反による債務は通常の無担保債務で免責されます。担保物を売却しても残った担保付債権者の不足額は一般無担保債権となり、免責されます。クレジットカードや医療費の債務も、詐欺などの例外に当たらない限り免責されます。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.12

questions.stem:
Which of the following acts by a debtor could result in a bankruptcy court revoking the debtor's discharge?

I. Failure to list one creditor
II. Failure to answer correctly material questions on the bankruptcy petition

choices.label: A
choices.text: I only

choices.label: B
choices.text: II only

choices.label: C
choices.text: Both I and II

choices.label: D
choices.text: Neither I nor II

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §727(d), the court may revoke a discharge if it was obtained through the debtor's fraud, or if the debtor committed acts such as refusing to answer a material question approved by the court (§727(a)(6)). Giving false answers to material questions on the bankruptcy petition is a false oath (§727(a)(4)); if the discharge was obtained through that fraud, the court may revoke it under §727(d)(1). Statement II can therefore result in revocation.

Failure to list one creditor does not cause the discharge to be revoked. Under §523(a)(3), the unscheduled debt may simply remain nondischargeable, while the discharge of the debtor's other debts stands. For this reason "I only" and "Both I and II" are wrong, and "Neither I nor II" is wrong because false answers to material questions can lead to revocation.
questions.explanationJa:
免責の取消し（§727(d)）は、免責が債務者の詐欺によって得られた場合や、裁判所が認めた重要な質問への回答拒否（§727(a)(6)）などがあった場合に認められます。破産申立書の重要な質問に正しく答えないことは虚偽の宣誓（§727(a)(4)）に当たり、それによって免責を得たときは詐欺による免責取得として取り消され得ます（§727(d)(1)）。したがって II は該当します。

債権者を1人載せなかっただけでは免責は取り消されず、その載せなかった債務が非免責になるにとどまります（§523(a)(3)）。そのため I を含む組み合わせは誤りで、どちらも該当しないとするのも誤りです。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.13

questions.stem: Under the liquidation provisions of Chapter 7 of the Federal Bankruptcy Code, certain property acquired by the debtor after the filing of the petition becomes part of the bankruptcy estate. An example of such property is

choices.label: A
choices.text: Inheritances received by the debtor within 180 days after the filing of the petition.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Child support payments received by the debtor within one year after the filing of the petition.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Social Security payments received by the debtor within 180 days after the filing of the petition.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Wages earned by the debtor within one year after the filing of the petition.

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §541(a)(5), property that the debtor acquires or becomes entitled to acquire within 180 days after the filing of the petition by bequest, devise, or inheritance, as a result of a property settlement or divorce decree, or as a beneficiary of a life insurance policy becomes property of the estate. An inheritance received within 180 days after filing is therefore included.

Child support payments received after filing are not among the post-petition property brought into the estate and are for the support of the child. Social Security benefits are protected from the claims of creditors by federal law and are not post-petition property brought into the estate. Wages earned by an individual Chapter 7 debtor for services performed after the filing are excluded from the estate under §541(a)(6).
questions.explanationJa:
申立て後180日以内に相続・遺贈、財産分与・離婚判決、生命保険の受益者として取得した財産は、破産財団に含まれます（§541(a)(5)）。したがって申立て後180日以内に受け取った相続財産が該当します。

申立て後に受け取る養育費は、財団に取り込まれる申立て後の財産に当たりません。社会保障給付は連邦法で債権者の差押えから保護されており、財団に含まれません。個人のチャプター7債務者が申立て後の労務で得た賃金は財団から除かれます（§541(a)(6)）。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.14

questions.stem: Which of the following transfers by a debtor, within ninety days of filing for bankruptcy, could be set aside as a preferential payment?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Making a gift to charity

choices.label: B
choices.text: Paying a business utility bill

choices.label: C
choices.text: Borrowing money from a bank secured by giving a mortgage on business property

choices.label: D
choices.text: Prepaying an installment loan on inventory

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §547(b), the trustee may avoid a transfer of the debtor's property to or for the benefit of a creditor, for or on account of an antecedent debt, made while the debtor was insolvent (presumed during the 90 days before filing under §547(f)), within 90 days before filing, that lets the creditor receive more than it would in a Chapter 7 liquidation. Prepaying an installment loan on inventory pays an existing (antecedent) debt ahead of schedule and prefers that lender, so it can be set aside.

A gift to charity is not a transfer to a creditor on an antecedent debt, so it is not a preference (it may be examined as a fraudulent transfer instead). Paying a business utility bill is a payment in the ordinary course of business protected by §547(c)(2). Borrowing money secured by a mortgage is a contemporaneous exchange for new value under §547(c)(1), not a payment of an antecedent debt.
questions.explanationJa:
偏頗行為（preference）として取り消せるのは、申立て前90日以内に、支払不能の状態で（90日間は支払不能と推定、§547(f)）、既存の債務（antecedent debt）について債権者に移転し、清算時より多く受け取らせる行為です（§547(b)）。在庫の割賦ローンの繰上げ返済は、既存債務を期限前に払って特定の債権者を優遇するので取り消せます。

慈善団体への寄付は債権者への既存債務の弁済ではないため偏頗行為に当たりません（詐害行為として問題になることはあります）。事業の公共料金の支払いは通常の事業過程の弁済として保護されます（§547(c)(2)）。抵当権を設定して新たに借り入れるのは、新たな価値との同時交換（§547(c)(1)）で、既存債務の弁済ではありません。

questions.stem: On June 5, Year 8, Gold rented equipment under a four-year lease. On March 8, Year 9, Gold was petitioned involuntarily into bankruptcy under the Federal Bankruptcy Code's liquidation provisions. A trustee was appointed. The fair market value of the equipment exceeds the balance of the lease payments due. The trustee

choices.label: A
choices.text: May not reject the equipment lease because the fair market value of the equipment exceeds the balance of the lease payments due

choices.label: B
choices.text: May elect not to assume the equipment lease

choices.label: C
choices.text: Must assume the equipment lease because its term exceeds one year

choices.label: D
choices.text: Must assume and subsequently assign the equipment lease

questions.explanation:
Under 11 U.S.C. §365(a), the trustee, subject to the court's approval, may assume or reject any executory contract or unexpired lease of the debtor. In a Chapter 7 case, an unexpired lease of personal property that the trustee does not assume within 60 days after the order for relief is deemed rejected (§365(d)(1)). The trustee therefore may elect not to assume the equipment lease.

The trustee is not barred from rejecting the lease because the equipment's fair market value exceeds the remaining lease payments; that fact only bears on whether assumption would benefit the estate. Nothing requires assumption because the lease term exceeds one year. Assignment under §365(f) is an option available after assumption, not a requirement.
questions.explanationJa:
管財人は、裁判所の承認を得て、債務者の未履行契約や期間の残っているリースを引き受ける（assume）ことも拒絶する（reject）こともできます（§365(a)）。チャプター7では、動産のリースを救済命令後60日以内に引き受けなければ拒絶したものとみなされます（§365(d)(1)）。したがって管財人はリースを引き受けないことを選べます。

設備の時価が残りのリース料を上回っていても拒絶できないわけではなく、それは引受けが財団に有利かどうかの判断材料にすぎません。リース期間が1年を超えるから引き受けなければならない、という規定はありません。譲渡（§365(f)）は引受け後に選べる手段で、義務ではありません。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.17

questions.stem:
Which of the following liens generally require(s) the lien holder to give notice of legal action before selling the debtor's property to satisfy the debt?

Mechanic's lien | Artisan's lien

choices.label: A
choices.text: Yes | Yes

choices.label: B
choices.text: Yes | No

choices.label: C
choices.text: No | Yes

choices.label: D
choices.text: No | No

questions.explanation:
Both liens are creditors' rights that can be enforced against the debtor's property only after notice to the debtor. A mechanic's lien on real property (for labor or materials that improved the property) is enforced through a judicial foreclosure action, and the owner must be given notice of the action before the property is sold. An artisan's lien is a possessory lien on personal property that the artisan repaired or improved; state lien statutes generally require the lien holder to give the owner notice before the property is sold to satisfy the debt.

"Yes | No" is wrong because an artisan's lien holder generally cannot sell the property without first notifying the owner. "No | Yes" is wrong because a mechanic's lien is enforced through a foreclosure action that requires notice to the owner. "No | No" ignores the notice requirement for both liens.
questions.explanationJa:
どちらの留置権（リーエン）も、債務者に通知したうえでなければ財産を売却して弁済に充てることはできません。メカニクス・リーエン（不動産の工事・資材の代金のための不動産上の担保権）は、裁判所での実行手続き（foreclosure）によって行使し、売却前に所有者へ通知が必要です。アーティザンズ・リーエン（修理・加工した動産を占有する留置権）も、州法上、売却前に所有者へ通知する必要があります。

アーティザンズ・リーエンは通知不要とする組み合わせ、メカニクス・リーエンは通知不要とする組み合わせ、どちらも通知不要とする組み合わせは、いずれも通知要件を見落としています。
questions.source: Proactive REG テキスト Bankruptcy Q.18

questions.stem: Which of the following will enable a creditor to collect money from a debtor's wages?

choices.label: A
choices.text: An order of receivership

choices.label: B
choices.text: An order of garnishment

choices.label: C
choices.text: A writ of execution

choices.label: D
choices.text: A writ of attachment

questions.explanation:
Garnishment is a creditor's remedy in which a court orders a third party that holds money owed to the debtor, such as the debtor's employer, to pay part of that money to the creditor. An order of garnishment therefore lets a creditor collect from the debtor's wages. Federal law (Consumer Credit Protection Act, 15 U.S.C. §1673) limits the amount of disposable earnings that can be garnished.

An order of receivership appoints a receiver to take charge of and preserve the debtor's property; it is not a means of reaching wages held by an employer. A writ of execution directs the sheriff to seize and sell the debtor's nonexempt property to satisfy a judgment. A writ of attachment is a prejudgment seizure of the debtor's property to secure a possible judgment. Neither writ is directed at wages owed by a third party.
questions.explanationJa:
差押命令（garnishment）は、債務者にお金を支払う立場にある第三者（雇用主など）に対し、その一部を債権者へ支払うよう裁判所が命じる債権回収手段です。したがって給与から回収できるのは差押命令です。差し押さえられる給与の額には連邦法（消費者信用保護法、15 U.S.C. §1673）の上限があります。

管財命令（receivership）は財産を管理・保全する管財人を選任するもので、雇用主が支払う給与を回収する手段ではありません。執行令状（writ of execution）は判決に基づき保安官が債務者の差押可能な財産を差し押さえて売却するもの、仮差押令状（writ of attachment）は判決前に債務者の財産を差し押さえるもので、いずれも第三者が支払う給与を対象とするものではありません。
